description: This file defines interfaces for a persistent storage system within the WPEFramework, including store operations, inspection, and limits, with associated notifications and scope types.

classes.name: IStore2
classes.description: Interface for a key-value store with scope, notification, and value management.

classes.name: IStoreInspector
classes.description: Interface for inspecting storage contents, keys, namespaces, and sizes.

classes.name: IStoreLimit
classes.description: Interface for setting and getting storage size limits per namespace.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for store events.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the store with a specified TTL.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value and its TTL from the store.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific key from the store.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace from the store.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaces
methods.description: Retrieves all namespaces within a scope.

methods.name: GetStorageSizes
methods.description: Retrieves storage sizes for all namespaces.

methods.name: SetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage size limit for a namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage size limit for a namespace.
